description: ORT Web native WebGPU EP (onnxruntime-web/webgpu, Safari-compatible asyncify build) and WASM EP. Per-model execution target from benchmarks and power policy; eligibility = load + known-answer + tolerance + latency/memory benchmark; respect adapter limits (maxBufferSize, shader-f16) and iOS memory. GPU-buffer residency for KV caches/recurrent state (preferredOutputLocation gpu-buffer). WebGPU device loss or failure disposes sessions and emits provider event. Runs in Even WebView on Android and iOS, and in Chrome (Android) / Safari (iOS). plan.md §6.1 WebGPU compute strategy.
title: ComputeRuntime (WebGPU/WASM) and per-model runtime selector
